rules.M: On a phone stopped by overlap, with the overlap still there, a block moved on desktop is taken out of the phone stack (the blocks under it rise by its height) and put back by rule G at its new desktop place: before the first block there that fits inside it; otherwise right after the blocks whose phone rows overlap, moving the blocks under that down by its height. Stopped by hand, or with the overlap gone, a move changes nothing on the phone.
rules.ours: A move on a stopped phone changes nothing there.
